releases.name: Classroom in Sora
releases.summary: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.

releases.name: Above Par
releases.summary: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.

releases.name: Chromagami
releases.summary: Team up with a comrade to fight an interdimensional paper war in this science-fiction, hero shooter.

releases.name: Graveyard Orbit
releases.summary: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

releases.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
releases.summary:
Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... for dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

Joining a crew of paleontologists at a new digsite, shovel your way down to many incredible discoveries. Piece together whole dino skeletons and analyze strange artifacts, uncovering lost secrets buried deep underground.

Sell off coins and treasure to build an arsenal of digging tools, then upgrade them to go deeper and find even more bones and loot!

releases.name: Cinderpeak
releases.summary: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

releases.name: Grave Ambition
releases.summary: They used the Overlord as a training dummy. Bad idea... In this casual voxel incremental action-RPG, every recruit you smash leaves a stat in your bones. Grind, evolve into new undead forms and climb seven floors to the five heroes who put you there.

releases.name: Tiny Dwellings
releases.summary: Tiny Dwellings is a cozy pixel-art builder with over 1,000 hand drawn items to place, decorate, and unwind with. Create charming little homes and tiny dioramas at your own pace, surrounded by calm lo-fi vibes, soft lighting, and cozy ambience.

releases.name: AI Lab Tycoon
releases.summary: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

releases.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED
releases.summary: Night shift at the municipal morgue. Bodies arrive with paperwork, and the paperwork has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature — listen to its chest. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

releases.name: Bullet Factory
releases.summary: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

releases.name: Expeditionary Sustainment Command
releases.summary: Command a U.S. Army Sustainment Company in a punishing military strategy campaign. Scout threats, clear routes, escort supplies, and lead armored and infantry offensives. Upgrade your fleet, develop your NCOs, and face the consequences of every loss.

releases.name: CLACKPOT: Marble Bounce Roguelike
releases.summary: A marble-bouncing roguelike! Pull back, let go, and score on every wall bounce. Combine balls with their own quirks, Patches and Relics across 24 interlocking Synergies into a build that's all your own, then climb higher past 53 rule-bending bosses!

releases.name: Ludoman
releases.summary: **Ludoman** is a life simulator set in snowy Russia. Pay off a 250,000-ruble mortgage, work, gamble your money, and explore an open world. One life, complete freedom, and multiple endings. Your fate is in your hands!

releases.name: Find The ZTA VI CD
releases.summary: With your team of 4, there are no rules in this chaotic battle: Don't fall for fake CDs, throw objects at your opponents, and defeat them at any cost. The first to find the real CD and reach the police wins. It's time to put your friendship to the test! The real ZTA VI CD will be in your hands!

releases.name: Frog Collector
releases.summary: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

releases.name: Debt Clicker
releases.summary: A satirical clicker where the goal isn't to get rich: it's to owe as much as possible. Click your credit card, spend what you borrow, sign every loan, and climb from a broke apartment to a mortgage on the Sun and a loan against Reality itself.

releases.name: Thoth's Riddle
releases.summary: Can you escape the Pyramid of Thoth? You have been tasked to explore the Pyramid and uncover its secrets. But you have fallen into the chamber and now must escape this mysterious Pyramid by solving 7 uniquely themed puzzles.

releases.name: Cabbie Chaos
releases.summary: An over-the-top arcade taxi game for 1–8 players, set in a crazy world full of nonsense! Grab a passenger and get them to their destination by any means necessary — over ramps, through parks, across frozen lakes and down into the sewers. Drive fast, drive crazy, and get paid for it!

releases.name: Swarmbreaker
releases.summary: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

releases.name: Let Me Die
releases.summary: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

releases.name: Bomb Them Ores
releases.summary: Why swing a pickaxe when you can blow the whole cave up? Bomb Them Ores is a chaotic incremental arcade game where bigger explosions mean better loot. Go deep, go loud, and find the treasure hiding far below.

releases.name: Bank Vault: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Organize a bank vault packed with 2,345 unique items! Sort cash, gold, and precious treasures, arrange every shelf, and turn chaos into order. Team up with friends in this satisfying tidying adventure!

releases.name: Spaceship Wars Together
releases.summary: Strap into a fully 3D starfighter and battle endless alien waves with up to 3 friends. Stack roguelite upgrades, chain class combos, fire your ultimate beam and bring down 11 colossal bosses - or turn your guns on each other in PvP dogfights.

releases.name: Warchaic
releases.summary: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.

releases.name: Marque & Reprisal
releases.summary: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

releases.name: Shoot'em & Scoot'em
releases.summary: Aliens stole your horse! Saddle up, take aim, and blast across space! Every shot rockets you the opposite way and you can change directions on a dime. Can you rescue Scooty?

releases.name: Next Acre
releases.summary: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.

releases.name: Freeze Line
releases.summary: Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower — no memory, a warm pocket watch, and your master's charge: gather time's scattered shards and mend the world. Freeze time, aim your dash, slip past all that wants you dead — then return to the one who sent you, and a truth that rewrites everything.

releases.name: Mini Legends Idle
releases.summary: A voxel fantasy idle RPG about farming loot, leveling up and refining your build. Collect weapons and armor, upgrade your gear and unlock rare spells!

releases.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED
releases.summary: A pattern of notes will be played. Tap the pattern to continue. Subconsciously maybe you'll learn the notes.

releases.name: Thanksgiving: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: The feast is over and Grandma’s farmhouse is a gravy-splattered disaster. Pick up, sort and put away up to 2,831 plates, pies, pumpkins and forks with up to 7 friends, while golden hour fades into a cozy, fire-lit night.

releases.name: Whittle Warband: An Incremental Auto-Battler
releases.summary: Build a warband, grow your woodland camp, and let your heroes fight. Choose a three-hero party, craft equipment, and shape your build with perks as you explore branching routes and challenge guardians in this pixel-art idle autobattler.

releases.name: GBald
releases.summary: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.

releases.name: Highschool J
releases.summary: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, shielded by a few friends, and consumed by poems he shares with no one. Until that transfer student arrives in class. Because some presences cannot be resisted. You can only surrender.
